meta.title: Lifting Safely
meta.persona: A calm, practical workplace trainer who speaks clearly and without urgency.

music.prompt: Quiet, warm instrumental with soft piano and no vocals.

beats.narration: Before lifting a box, pause and look at where it needs to go. A clear route makes the next steps easier to plan.
beats.visual: A worker checks the path beside a box.

beats.narration: Check the box and its label before you move it. If the load seems awkward or too heavy, stop and ask for help.
beats.visual: The worker points at a label, then asks a colleague.

beats.narration: Move close to the box so you can keep it near your body. Make sure your feet are steady before beginning the lift.
beats.visual: The worker steps close and sets their feet.

beats.narration: Bend your knees and keep your back in a comfortable, stable position. Lift smoothly, keeping the box close as you stand up.
beats.visual: The worker bends at the knees and lifts the box.

beats.narration: While carrying the box, look ahead and take steady steps. If you need to turn, move your feet instead of twisting your body.
beats.visual: The worker takes short steps and turns their feet.

beats.narration: At the destination, lower the box with control. Check that it rests securely, then take a moment to make sure the route stays clear.
beats.visual: The box is set down securely and the path remains clear.
